data.name: Mijdad
data.long_meaning: Mijdad is a name derived from the Arabic word 'mujaddid' which means 'renewer' or 'reviver'. In Islamic history, Mijdad ibn Amr As-Sadusi was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a brave warrior in the Battle of Uhud. This name is often given to boys in the Muslim world as a symbol of courage and loyalty.
